crm_notes: POC objective: replace/manual macros + reduce AHT by 20% via agent-assist + automated ticket summaries for Tier 1.
Primary retrieval sources: Zendesk tickets (search index), Confluence KB, S3 archived transcripts. Need multi-source ranker + citation annotation (customers must see origin).

Latency targets: retrieval + RAG assembly <120ms for lookups; end-to-end assist response ~200-300ms (soft). Peak capacity: normally ~40 concurrent agents, must handle spikes to ~500 concurrent for promos/incident windows without dropping service.
Model preferences: open quantized models allowed (Llama 3 / Mistral 7B-13B) for private deployment; want fallback to hosted smaller variant during node failure.
Cost sensitivity: mid-market — willing to pay for predictability. Interested in Optimize recommendations for batching & quantization to lower token costs.
technical_requirements: Retrieval freshness: must support incremental ingestion with <1h freshness for ticket edits and KB updates.
Citations: every returned snippet must have source ID + link (Zendesk ticket id or Confluence page) and confidence score.
Multi-source ranking: prefer hybrid BM25+embedding re-ranker; results deduplicated across sources.
Tool-calling: agent assist must surface canonical 'update-ticket' and 'create-escalation' tool calls with RBAC control.
Failover: automatic fallback to cached summary layer + lower-capacity model when GPU pool saturated; circuit-breaker metrics required.
Observability: per-request token/latency breakdown, per-route error traces, and SLA alerts for >5% degraded latency over 15m windows.
procurement_notes: Legal: wants data residency clause (EU only) for EU customers; otherwise US-hosted for NA accounts.
SLA: asking for 99.9% availability for agent-assist endpoints and defined RTO for failover between private/dedicated modes.
Billing: prefers committed reserved capacity model if predictable — interested in 1yr Dedicated commit after successful POC.
